comments.body_html:
Awesome mod, works as expected!

Couple of questions regarding Tarkov’s seasons:

  • Earlier when I played Tarkov about a year ago, there was a season which looked like late autumn but with a little bit of snow cover here and there. Do you know does that season still exist? I’ve quickly tested out all the listed seasons, but “Autumn” was orange/brownish autumn and “LateAutumn” was grey but without snow. Meanwhile “Winter” has full snow cover and the ground is completely covered in snow. Is the snow on the ground random in this game? I miss the mix of late autumn and winter ;(
  • Do you know what is “Storm”? I tried it out and it looked exactly like “Summer”.

comments.author: bushtail
comments.body_html: Unfortunately, no. This runs before the client requests the local weather is requested from the server (during raid start) - it runs a randomization function prior to the weather config being sent to the client. I could poke at making it work like that, but i’m not sure how yet.
